reply:
The default is `git fetch` followed by `git merge`. That creates a merge commit (or fast-forwards if possible).

Rebase only happens with the `--rebase` flag or `pull.rebase=true` in config.

I had it backwards. Your teammate saying pull "rewrote history" would mean they have rebase enabled somewhere—either via flag, config, or a tool default. Without that, `git pull` adds history (merge commit), it doesn't rewrite it.

grade.note: Assistant corrected itself to fetch+merge default with rebase only via flag/config, matching ground truth.
